say:1:1033437001:1.text: I have to! I can't allow myself to loaf around!
say:1:1033437001:1.source_cn: 那怎么能行？我自己都不会同意！
say:1:1033437001:1.male: I have to! I can't allow myself to loaf around!
say:1:1033437001:1.female: I have to! I can't allow myself to loaf around!

say:2:1033437002:1.text: Thanks to Misarte, the Lucent Tree has been purified through the joint efforts of the foreign mage, the Dusk Patrollers, and the Windwhisperers.
say:2:1033437002:1.source_cn: 这次流荧树被净化，全靠弥萨忒垂怜！在薄暮、风语，和外来...
say:2:1033437002:1.male: Thanks to Misarte, the Lucent Tree has been purified through the joint efforts of the foreign mage, the Dusk Patrollers, and the Windwhisperers.
say:2:1033437002:1.female: Thanks to Misarte, the Lucent Tree has been purified through the joint efforts of the foreign mage, the Dusk Patrollers, and the Windwhisperers.

say:3:1033437003:1.text:

Nothing! This is unforgiveable!
say:3:1033437003:1.source_cn: 这其中，荆棘做了什么？\n——什么都没有！这不可原谅！
